name: The Chess Club
description: Regulars at the chess club each swear by a different opening, a favourite tactic, and a prized set. Work out who plays what.
clues: Either Discovery goes with Benoni or someone in the Morning Study Group goes with Benoni.
The player who loves the Pin and Vera are in the same camp.
Zwischenzug goes with exactly one of Vera, Caro-Kann, or Sicilian.
Nadia, French, and Fork belong to different players.
Pin goes with none of Garry, Mikhail, or Vera.
Between Discovery and Fork, one goes with Garry and the other with London.
Pin goes with either Mikhail or French (but not both).
Sicilian does not go with Zwischenzug.
